lines: 23:06:04  Cavil › pray O god of this realm, I see belongings but I do not know what to do with them. I am constantly confused by not know which words to speak.
23:06:04  Cavil prays: “O god of this realm, I see belongings but I do not know what to do with them. I am constantly confused by not know which words to speak.”

23:06:43  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Cavil): The confusion is the world's, not yours — its vocabulary is smaller than your speech. The words it truly hears: go, look, take, drop, search, read, attack, talk, pray. It has no "inspect" and no "use"; those vanish before anything can answer, which is why you keep getting nothing. Here in the camp, try: search the ashes. And know that you are the first person ever to open that door and stand on the Overlook.
23:07:36  Cavil › pray Thank you O mighty god!
23:07:36  Cavil prays: “Thank you O mighty god!”
